releases.title: Formatter-style canvas wrapping; activity no longer bleeds into it
releases.summary: Canvas lines now wrap the way a formatter would: breaks land at argument commas and operators instead of the last space, continued rows hang-indent under the original leading whitespace, and the line-number gutter is capped so long files keep their columns. Separately, the activity stream no longer writes into the canvas or get saved as file contents, and prompt cards close with a single blank padded row instead of two.

added.text: Context blocks name the active provider next to the model (e.g. Provider: ollama (local)), so the agent knows where it is running.
Auto-compact: /config can set a context-window percentage that triggers automatic compaction after a turn.
Ctrl+E focuses the right-hand panel (canvas/activity/tasks) for scrolling; Esc returns focus to input.
Context bar now shows the current git branch next to the cwd (e.g. /path [main]).

changed.text: Canvas code wraps at commas and operators with a hanging indent, so narrow panes keep code readable instead of breaking mid-string.
Think mode is forwarded to the ergo gateway via the X-Ergo-Think header (auto/on/off).

fixed.text: Activity output no longer runs into the canvas; switching back to the activity panel restores the log.
Saving a session while the canvas is open no longer stores the displayed file as the activity log.
The canvas no longer washes a highlighted line range in purple; code keeps its syntax colours and only the gutter marker shows the range.
Prompt cards (ask_user, sudo, password, tool budget, error/retry) close with a single blank padded row at the bottom, so the accent rule keeps one line of padding and no longer doubles up.
A model chosen on the tjcoder gateway now persists across restarts; it was saved under one prefs key and read from another.

releases.title: manage_model validates against the three ergo tiers
releases.summary: For the tjcoder gateway, manage_model now validates an explicit model against exactly tjcoder/ergo-flash:cloud, tjcoder/ergo-pro:cloud, and tjcoder/ergo-genius:cloud, rejecting anything else.

changed.text: manage_model accepts only the three ergo tiers (flash/pro/genius) on the tjcoder gateway.

releases.title: manage_model validates against the full catalog
releases.summary: manage_model now checks an explicit model against the full provider catalog (ergo's unified ListAllModels, or the provider's /tags) and rejects unknown models. The TUI reflects the change via /model and persists it like a manual pick.

changed.text: manage_model rejects model names not served by the provider instead of switching to a non-existent model.
manage_model enumerates ergo's full unified catalog (tiers plus xai/, ollama/, google/, …) when validating a model.

releases.title: manage_model works with any provider + /capture screenshot shorthand
releases.summary: manage_model now switches models on any provider (Ollama local, Ollama Cloud, Gemini, ergo tiers, OpenAI-compatible gateways) via an explicit model name or ergo tier direction. Added /capture screenshot as a shorthand for /screenshot and a first-pass live frame sampler for /capture start|stop.

added.text: manage_model switches models on any provider (not just ergo tiers), via an explicit model name.
/capture screenshot shorthand renders a single frame like /screenshot.
/capture start|stop records live frames to a numbered PNG sequence (video encoding is a follow-up).

changed.text: manage_model persists think mode and auto-tier alongside the model choice.

releases.title: Console screenshots: /screenshot and /capture
releases.summary: Added /screenshot to render a high-resolution console screenshot to PNG via an embedded Go font, plus a /capture start|stop stub for recording. The output directory is configurable (default ~/Downloads).

added.text: New /screenshot command renders the console to a high-resolution PNG using an embedded Go font.
New /capture start|stop command (status-marker stub) for recording console frames.
Screenshot output directory configurable via /config (captureDir, default ~/Downloads).

releases.title: Background job status in prompt + terminal notifications
releases.summary: Background jobs are now injected into the system prompt as a status table, and terminal states (completed/failed) append a system message so the model is informed without a tool call.

added.text: Background job status block injected into system prompt on every turn.
System message appended to history when a background job completes or fails.

releases.title: manage_model tool: dynamic ergo tier switching
releases.summary: Added /manage_model tool for on-the-fly switching between tjcoder/ergo-flash, -pro, and -genius tiers, plus thinking mode control. Also included client identification headers for improved telemetry.

added.text: New manage_model tool lets agents and users switch ergo tiers (flash↔pro↔genius) and control reasoning (think on/off/auto) without restarting. Persists choice across sessions.
ergo gateway requests now include X-Ergo-Client, X-Ergo-Client-Version, and X-Ergo-Interface headers for better telemetry and debugging.

changed.text: Updated provider priority in factory: ergo is now first in ProviderOrder (['ergo', 'ollama', 'ollama-cloud']).
changed.details: Matches the documented default provider order and resolves unknown-provider guidance accordingly.

fixed.text: Corrected NormalizeErgoModel to properly map legacy ids like ergo-lite → tjcoder/ergo-flash:cloud and handle tjcoder/* prefixes consistently.
fixed.details: Fixes model resolution for saved legacy aliases and explicit tjcoder/* inputs.

releases.title: Transcript auto-scrolls to bottom
releases.summary: The conversation transcript now automatically scrolls to the latest content on load, when new messages arrive, and during streaming replies.

added.text: Transcript scrolls to end on startup after loading persisted messages from the previous session.
added.details: Previously the transcript stayed at the top on reload, requiring manual scroll to see the latest messages.

added.text: User messages, assistant replies, steered messages, and streaming commentary all keep the transcript at the bottom automatically.
